description: Build a bank payment payload: a Pix BR Code (Brazil), a SEPA credit transfer (EPC069-12, euro area), or a PayNow (Singapore), PromptPay (Thailand) or VietQR (Vietnam) code, EMV merchant-presented with its CRC. Fields depend on the scheme. Pass the result as `data` to generate_qr_code; use error correction M for SEPA.

amount.description: Amount in the scheme's currency (BRL, EUR, SGD, THB, or whole VND). Leave out to let the payer choose.

bic.description: sepa: BIC, optional inside the EEA

city.description: pix: receiver city, up to 15 characters

editable.description: paynow: whether the payer may change the amount (default true)

expiry.description: paynow: last day the code works, YYYY-MM-DD

message.description: pix or vietqr: message for the payer

name.description: pix: receiver name (required, up to 25 characters); sepa: beneficiary name (required); paynow: name shown to the payer

pixKey.description: pix: CPF, CNPJ, +55 phone, email or random key

proxy.description: paynow or promptpay: the mobile number, UEN, national/tax ID or e-wallet ID

proxyType.description: paynow: mobile or uen; promptpay: mobile, id or ewallet

reference.description: sepa: structured RF creditor reference; paynow: bill reference

remittance.description: sepa: payment reference text, up to 140 characters (not with reference)

scheme.description: pix (Brazil), sepa (euro credit transfer, EPC069-12), paynow (Singapore), promptpay (Thailand) or vietqr (Vietnam)

txid.description: pix: transaction ID, up to 25 letters and digits

name: qr_payload_payment
title: Bank payment QR payload
